import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native, layout, fib, main as M
from protocol import parse_request
cases=parse_request(open('/workspace/tmp/fail1.json','rb').read())
native.try_build()
case=cases[0]
versions=fib.publish(case["initial"],case["transactions"])
per=[[] for _ in versions]
for version,repeat,addresses in case["bursts"]:
    st=versions[version][0]
    per[version].append((repeat,[fib.run_index(st,a) for a in addresses]))
lay=native.plan(versions,per,case["costs"],case["cache_pages"])
starts,hops=versions[0]
nodes=lay[0]
size=len(starts)
print("call:", M.check_layout(starts,hops,nodes))
print("pre:", size, fib.MAX_RUNS, len(nodes), 2*size-1, nodes[0]["lo"], nodes[0]["span"])
ends=[n["lo"]+n["span"] for n in nodes]
order,queue=[],[0]
while queue:
    index=queue.pop(0); order.append(index); node=nodes[index]
    if not layout.legal(node,starts): print("legal fail",index); break
    children=node["children"]
    if children:
        if len(children)<2 or len(children)>9 or len(children)>node["span"]:
            print("fanout fail",index,children,node["span"]); break
        cursor=node["lo"]; bad=False
        for child in children:
            if not index<child<len(nodes) or child in order:
                print("order fail",index,child,order); bad=True; break
            if nodes[child]["lo"]!=cursor or ends[child]>ends[index]:
                print("part fail",index,child,cursor,nodes[child]["lo"],ends[child],ends[index]); bad=True; break
            cursor=ends[child]
        if bad: break
        if cursor!=ends[index]: print("cover fail",index); break
    elif node["span"]>8: print("leaf fail",index); break
    queue.extend(children)
else:
    print("order",order,list(range(len(nodes))))
